newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says will tackle reform plan seriously.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says will tackle reform plan seriously.

text.p: Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told a news conference on Thursday that his ministry would work out specific steps to reform itself based on proposals unveiled by the ruling coalition on Wednesday.

He was referring to a proposal that an independent body be set up to take over the exclusive supervisory and regulatory role through which the ministry has long exercised control over Japan's financial industry.
"We have to seriously work out concrete steps in accordance with the coalition's reform ideas," Ogawa said.
